description: Add a task to the Gantt chart — a piece of work with a start and end date, which is what time blocks are later logged against. Use this for work that spans days or longer; for time already worked use log_time instead. Writes to the user's real plan, so confirm the project, name and dates with them first. Requires the tasks:write scope; an end-to-end-encrypted project also needs PYUNTO_TM_PASSWORD so the name can be encrypted locally.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. May be years out.

name.description: What the task is. Encrypted client-side.

parent_task_id.description: Make this a subtask of that task, in the same project.

name: create_task
